Tata Communications plans a 10,000-kilometer India AI Super Highway with up to $450 million investment, and the office should track infrastructure expansion.
OneQode secured 14 MW of Chennai AI capacity in an AdaniConneX agreement, and the office must monitor data center developments.
Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready data center in Chennai, and the office should follow up on regional AI investments.
CPIM accused the TVK government of moving towards privatization during a protest in Vyasarpadi, and the office should note political opposition.
MP Kanimozhi accused the TVK government of failing to control Aavin product prices, and the office must watch public reactions.
